metadata.title: ai-bot-builder - Sources
metadata.description: Official and adjacent sources for building production AI bots with pure Python frameworks.

official_sources.name: LangGraph GitHub
official_sources.description: Official LangGraph repository for stateful agent and bot workflows.

official_sources.name: LangGraph Docs
official_sources.description: Official LangGraph documentation for graph design, state, persistence, and runtime.

official_sources.name: LangSmith Docs
official_sources.description: Tracing, debugging, and evaluation for LangGraph-based bot systems.

official_sources.name: Pipecat GitHub
official_sources.description: Open-source framework for voice and multimodal conversational AI with composable pipeline processors.

official_sources.name: Pipecat Docs
official_sources.description: Official Pipecat documentation for pipeline design, transport layers, and processor patterns.

official_sources.name: LiveKit Agents GitHub
official_sources.description: LiveKit's agent framework for real-time voice and multimodal AI applications.

official_sources.name: LiveKit Agents Docs
official_sources.description: Official LiveKit Agents documentation for voice agent sessions, plugins, and deployment.

official_sources.name: Claude Agent SDK Docs
official_sources.description: Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK for building tool-using agents and bots with Claude models. Canonical URL verified 2026-06-09 (old docs.claude.com path redirects here via platform.claude.com).

official_sources.name: Claude Agent SDK Python
official_sources.description: Python reference implementation of the Claude Agent SDK.

official_sources.name: Model Context Protocol
official_sources.description: MCP spec and reference servers for typed tool contracts between bots and external systems.

official_sources.name: Pydantic AI Docs
official_sources.description: Pydantic AI documentation for Agent capabilities, migration guides, and the installed release. Check the current extension-point APIs before upgrading.

official_sources.name: LangGraph Releases
official_sources.description: LangGraph release history for the Python compatibility range and checkpoint APIs of the release you plan to pin.

official_sources.name: OpenAI Agents SDK — Handoffs
official_sources.description: OpenAI Agents SDK handoffs vs agents-as-tools guidance for multi-agent routing. Default to agents-as-tools; use handoffs only for full control transfer.

memory_vendors.name: Mem0 Docs
memory_vendors.description: Managed memory layer — best for P2 (structured) + P6 (episodic-semantic) in support bots.

memory_vendors.name: Zep Docs
memory_vendors.description: Temporal knowledge-graph memory — best for P4 (sales bots, customer success).

memory_vendors.name: Graphiti GitHub
memory_vendors.description: Open-source temporal knowledge-graph library underlying Zep.

memory_vendors.name: Cognee Docs
memory_vendors.description: Poly-store memory with four-verb lifecycle — best for P5 + P7 (knowledge bots).

memory_vendors.name: Letta Docs
memory_vendors.description: OS-style context management with self-editing memory — best for P3 (long-running agents).

memory_vendors.name: LangGraph Store
memory_vendors.description: Application-owned namespaced key-value memory for P2 patterns inside LangGraph.

adjacent_references.name: Zendesk API
adjacent_references.description: Zendesk REST API for support bot ticket integration.

adjacent_references.name: Intercom API
adjacent_references.description: Intercom API for conversational support bot integration.

adjacent_references.name: HubSpot API
adjacent_references.description: HubSpot CRM API for sales bot lead and deal management.

adjacent_references.name: Salesforce API
adjacent_references.description: Salesforce REST API for CRM-integrated sales bots.

adjacent_references.name: WhatsApp Business API
adjacent_references.description: Meta WhatsApp Business API for bot channel integration.

adjacent_references.name: Twilio Messaging API
adjacent_references.description: Twilio SMS and messaging API for text-based bot channels.

adjacent_references.name: Promptfoo
adjacent_references.description: Open-source LLM evaluation framework for bot conversation testing and red-teaming.

adjacent_references.name: Google Conversation Design Guidelines
adjacent_references.description: Google's conversation design best practices for conversational AI.

adjacent_references.name: Anthropic Cookbook — Verify with Outcome Grader
adjacent_references.description: Anthropic pattern: isolated grader agent scores a draft against an explicit rubric and triggers a capped revision loop. Runtime outcome guard for load-bearing answers. Evidence grade C (vendor cookbook).

security_sources.name: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025
security_sources.description: Canonical LLM risk taxonomy — LLM01:2025 Prompt Injection is the #1 class.

security_sources.name: Anthropic — Mitigate Jailbreaks and Prompt Injection
security_sources.description: Anthropic's official guidance on injection defense patterns, spotlighting, and input/output filters.

security_sources.name: NVIDIA garak
security_sources.description: Open-source LLM vulnerability scanner for injection, jailbreak, and data-exfiltration tests.

security_sources.name: Meta Prompt Guard 2
security_sources.description: Small classifier for detecting direct and indirect prompt-injection attempts at the input edge.

security_sources.name: GLiGuard (arXiv 2605.07982)
security_sources.description: Lightweight generalist guardrail classifier for prompt-injection / jailbreak detection. Evidence grade C (preprint). Thank you to arXiv for use of its open access interoperability.

security_sources.name: FlexGuard (arXiv 2602.23636)
security_sources.description: Adaptive guardrail with tunable strictness for input/output safety filtering. Evidence grade C (preprint). Thank you to arXiv for use of its open access interoperability.
